title: 24w20a Enjoyer
body:
### THIS RESOURCE PACK DOES NOT REPEAT THE SOUNDS FROM THE 24W20A SNAPSHOT

A lightweight resource pack that changes the sounds of pistons to the sound of a spring and the sounds of explosions to a more realistic explosion sound.
